description: On the acropolis hill called Monte Smith, four restored Doric columns and a short piece of entablature stand on a stone platform, with pines around them and the Aegean beyond. The morning is clear, about 21.8°C, with wind about 21.5 km/h. The medieval palace, the Street of the Knights, and Lindos are not in the frame.
